text:
Type: arched white table clock
Use: telling time on a desk, a shelf, a sideboard or a bedside; home office, living room, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, contemporary
Materials: matte white plastic case, white face, black hands, light turquoise second hand and dial ring
Colors: off-white, light turquoise, black
Shape: freestanding block with a rounded arched top and flat front, round inset dial with slim hour marks, compact and soft-edged
Feel: calm, fresh, clean, friendly
Goes with: white or light wood desks, pastel accents, white walls; Scandinavian or minimalist home offices and bedrooms

product.name: POFFARE
product.description: You can place the clock in different locations  on a wall, over a door or standing on a surface  then turn the clock face to suit the location.
